items.lede: United is apparently experiencing a major outage just days after a nationwide ground stop halted thousands of flights.
items.title: United Airlines has fixed issue that caused 'widespread system outage'

items.lede: Less than a week after an issue with air traffic control communications and radar caused the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide, United Airlines departing flights are being disrupted by an outage.
